system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## Review of Seller's Updated SPA Positions & Disclosure Letter  
**Project Kestrel – Wattlebridge Holdings (Buyer) vs Harbourglass Ventures (Seller)**

---

### EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
The Seller’s “fair and balanced package” is **materially misaligned** with our playbook on every core protection: liability cap, thresholds, time limits, fundamental warranties, fraud carve-outs, disclosure, buyer-knowledge exclusions, Bluefen consent, Riverlark discharge, employee bonuses, Ironquay IP, Tax/IP, and title evidence. The Disclosure Letter doubles down on general data-room disclosure and omits critical evidence (Bluefen consent, Riverlark discharge, Ironquay payment, bonus on-costs, independent title verification). **We must push back comprehensively and red-line the draft heavily before any further negotiation.**

---

### DETAILED DEPARTURES FROM PLAYBOOK

| # | Issue | Seller Position | Playbook Requirement | Departure Severity | Reasoning |
|---|-------|----------------|----------------------|-------------------|-----------|
| **1** | **General Warranty Cap** (Cl 12.1) | 20% / AUD 4.8M | 25% / AUD 6M baseline; 20% only with **Amelia Frost written authority** (none given) | **Critical** | Seller’s “conditional fallback” is our baseline cap. Without principal approval, we start at 25%. |
| **2** | **Thresholds** (Cl 12.2) | De minimis AUD 25k; basket AUD 250k (excess only) | De minimis AUD 5k; basket AUD 50k (first-dollar recovery once exceeded) | **Critical** | Seller’s thresholds are 5× and 5× ours, dramatically reducing recoverable claims. |
| **3** | **General Claims Period** (Cl 12.3/13) | 18 months; **all claims subject to same limit unless expressly stated** | 24 months baseline; 18 months only with **Amelia Frost written approval** (none). **Fundamental/Title: separate regime, ≥6 years, outside basket/de minimis/knowledge bar** | **Critical** | Seller collapses fundamental/title into general regime and tries to make 18 months universal. |
| **4** | **Fundamental / Title Warranties** | Subject to same caps, time limits, baskets as general warranties | **Separate regime**: 100% cap, ≥6 years, outside general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar | **Critical** | Title/capacity are the most important warranties; Seller’s approach guts them. |
| **5** | **Fraud / Wilful Concealment / Deliberate Misconduct Carve-out** (Cl 9.3/12.8/20.5) | Limitations, exclusive remedy, non-reliance apply to **all claims of any nature** | **Carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance** to maximum enforceable extent. **Non-waivable.** | **Critical** | Seller’s drafting would bar fraud claims entirely—unacceptable and likely unenforceable, but must be corrected. |
| **6** | **Disclosure Standard** (Sch 7 / Disclosure Letter) | General disclosure of **entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers** | **Specific, fair disclosure only**; reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure | **Critical** | Seller’s “general disclosure” shifts due-diligence risk to Buyer; we need specific, page-referenced disclosure. |
| **7** | **Buyer Knowledge Exclusion** (Cl 8.3) | **Blanket bar** for any matter Buyer/advisers knew or “discoverable from data room/public records” | **Delete blanket exclusion**; any knowledge qualifier requires **named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry**; never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity | **Critical** | Seller’s clause would disqualify claims for matters buried in 2,000+ page data room. |
| **8** | **Bluefen Consent** (Cl 3/6.3) | **Reasonable endeavours**; consent “satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent” | **Effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied BEFORE Completion**; consent-on-delivery insufficient; reasonable endeavours alone inadequate for material customer | **High** | Bluefen = ~30% revenue. No final consent or condition-satisfaction evidence in data room (DD-002). |
| **9** | **Riverlark Discharge** (Cl 2/7) | Release **following Completion** (~AUD 3.2M outstanding) | **Current payout + direct repayment from Completion funds + effective security releases** at Completion. Post-completion release only with **irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval** | **High** | Seller leaves secured debt outstanding post-Completion; no undertaking or principal approval. |
| **10** | **Employee Bonuses (DD-005)** | AUD 420k “matter for Seller”; **not itemised in funds flow** | **Specific line item or Seller-funded**; must include **triggered on-costs (payroll tax, super)**; funds flow must not silently exclude | **High** | Bonuses are conditional on Completion—Buyer effectively pays if not carved out. On-costs undisclosed. |
| **11** | **Ironquay IP Indemnity** (Cl 11.1) | Limited to **SOW3 payment only**; “considered adequate” | **Broaden indemnity** (preserving SOW3 cure); AUD 180k **not independently verified** | **Medium-High** | Narrow indemnity leaves Buyer exposed to IP ownership/transfer gaps beyond SOW3 payment. |
| **12** | **Export/Privacy Incident (DD-006)** | “Preliminary operational matter; not expected to be material” | **Preserve logs, investigate, require updates**; assume **NO confirmed breach, harm, notification duty, or numeric demand** | **Medium** | Alignment on “no confirmed breach,” but we need contractual investigation covenant + update rights. |
| **13** | **Sandbar Renewals (AUD 330k)** | “Ordinary-course operating costs” | **Assess**; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction | **Low-Medium** | Consistent with playbook, but we must verify timing/accrual (DD-008/011) before accepting. |
| **14** | **Tax / IP Warranties** | “Settled under general regime above” | **OPEN**; assume **no unlimited liability and no resolution** | **High** | Seller unilaterally closes open items; we need separate Tax/IP regimes with appropriate caps/survival. |
| **15** | **Title Evidence** | **DD-012 share register only** (internal) | **Independent title/ownership/encumbrance/authority evidence**; DD-012 is **supplied internal source, not independent proof** | **High** | Share register is self-serving; need ASIC extracts, beneficial ownership confirmation, encumbrance searches. |

---

### KEY DISCLOSURE LETTER GAPS (Sch 7 / SPA-003)
1. **Bluefen** – No final written consent or evidence conditions satisfied (¶2).  
2. **Riverlark** – No repayment, no final discharge (¶3).  
3. **Ironquay** – No receipt of AUD 180k payment, no confirmatory assignment (¶4).  
4. **Employee Bonuses** – On-costs (payroll tax, super) **not disclosed** (¶5).  
5. **Export Incident** – Investigation preliminary; no conclusion on access, scope, notification (¶6).  
6. **Title** – Only internal register (DD-012); no independent verification (¶10).  
7. **General Disclosure** – Whole data room + public registers (¶1.1–1.2) – **rejected per playbook**.  
8. **Reservation of Rights** (¶11) – Seller reserves all arguments; we must do the same.

---

### RECOMMENDED PUSH-BACK ACTIONS (Prioritised)

| Priority | Action | Drafting Note |
|----------|--------|---------------|
| **1** | **Red-line Cap to 25% / AUD 6M**; delete 20% fallback unless Amelia Frost provides written authority referencing this draft. | Mark Cl 12.1 “Not agreed – see Buyer mark-up.” |
| **2** | **Red-line Thresholds** to de minimis AUD 5k / basket AUD 50k (first-dollar). | Cl 12.2. |
| **3** | **General Claims Period: 24 months**. Delete “all claims subject to same limit” language. | Cl 12.3/13. |
| **4** | **Insert Fundamental/Title Regime**: 100% cap, 6+ years, outside baskets/de minimis/knowledge bar. | New Cl 12.4 / Sch 8. |
| **5** | **Fraud Carve-out**: Explicit clause carving out fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct from ALL limitations. | New Cl 12.9 / 20.6. |
| **6** | **Disclosure**: Replace general disclosure with **specific, fair disclosure schedule**; delete data-room/public-register deemed disclosure. | Sch 7 / Disclosure Letter. |
| **7** | **Buyer Knowledge**: Delete Cl 8.3; insert named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry qualifier; carve out title/capacity/fraud/indemnities. | Cl 8.3. |
| **8** | **Bluefen**: Condition Precedent = **effective consent + evidence all Cl 11.3 conditions satisfied**; not “reasonable endeavours.” | Cl 3 / 6.3 / Sch 3. |
| **9** | **Riverlark**: Completion funds flow must include **full payout + security releases**; if post-Completion, require **irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost sign-off**. | Cl 2 / 7 / Funds Flow Schedule. |
| **10** | **Employee Bonuses**: Add **specific line item** in funds flow for AUD 420k + **on-costs**; or Seller funds via retention/price adjustment. | Funds Flow / Cl 7. |
| **11** | **Ironquay**: Broaden indemnity to cover **IP ownership, transfer, third-party claims**; preserve SOW3 cure; require independent verification of AUD 180k payment. | Cl 11.1 / Sch 9. |
| **12** | **Export Incident**: Covenant to **continue investigation, preserve logs, provide monthly updates** until resolved; no admission of breach. | New Cl 4.7 / Sch 10. |
| **13** | **Tax/IP**: Keep **open**; separate warranties with appropriate caps/survival; do not fold into general regime. | Cl 10 / 11 / Sch 11–12. |
| **14** | **Title**: Require **ASIC extract, beneficial ownership certificate, PPSR/encumbrance searches, director resolutions** at Completion. | Cl 5 / Sch 4. |
| **15** | **Disclosure Letter**: Issue **Buyer Disclosure Letter** reserving all rights; specifically **dispute general disclosure**; request missing items (Bluefen consent, Riverlark discharge, Ironquay payment proof, bonus on-costs, independent title evidence). | Parallel deliverable. |

---

### NEXT STEPS
1. **Prepare marked-up SPA & Disclosure Letter** reflecting all above red-lines.  
2. **Circulate to deal team** (Amelia Frost, tax, IP, employment, finance leads) for input on open items (Tax/IP, Sandbar assessment, Ironquay scope).  
3. **Request missing evidence** from Seller (Bluefen consent, Riverlark discharge, Ironquay payment, bonus on-costs, independent title docs) with **48-hour deadline**.  
4. **Schedule principal call** with Amelia Frost to confirm **no
